includes: // Every brand's kitchen sink is GENERATED from its definition by
// `bun run guidelines` — they document the system rather than being
// authored, and formatting one by hand would be undone on the next run.
// Likewise the brand stylesheets. Their shape comes from a brand
// definition and the generator's rules — a stylistic complaint about
// one is a complaint about the generator, and fixing it in the output
// would survive exactly until the next `bun run build:packages`.
// The ux-ui-agent-skills kit is VENDORED reference material, not source
// this repo authors: 138 design-system descriptions, DTCG token
// references, component specs and the gate scripts, installed by
// `bunx ux-ui-agent-skills init`. Reformatting them would put the repo
// permanently at odds with upstream and make every kit update a
// conflict, for files nobody here edits.
// The kit's gate scripts live in `scripts/`, beside this repo's own
// `render-guidelines.ts`, so they are named rather than ignored
// wholesale — the one script this repo authors stays linted.
